news.headline: NWS Melbourne Sun Nov 22 afternoon: sunny and dry in Melbourne, 79°F at 4 PM with rain chances 1-10% through Monday; River Flood Warning continues — St. Johns River near Cocoa was at a record 18.7 feet at 8:15 AM in major flood, above Lake Harney at 12.8 feet forecast to crest at 13.1 feet tonight, Astor in major flood and Sanford in moderate flood forecast to reach major this week; Rip Current Statement in effect until 7 PM Sun

Gateway Jax opens Vandeveer at Pearl Square in downtown Jacksonville — the seven-story, 205-unit rental building at 515 North Pearl Street opened Nov 18 as the first completed residential building at Pearl Square, a nine-block mixed-use district planning four apartment buildings totaling about 1,270 units through 2030; the $66 million project includes more than 22,000 square feet of ground-floor retail

Vertical construction underway on Cypress Grove Apartments in Largo — Orlando-based Archway Partners' $31.85 million project south of downtown Largo will bring 84 income-restricted apartments in three garden-style buildings, affordable for at least 30 years, with completion expected late 2027; site preparation began in June
news.source: St. Pete Rising via The Cooldown

news.headline: Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper fell more than 5% Wed to its lowest since April — LME three-month copper fell 4.6% Nov 18 to $12,471 per tonne and Comex fell as much as 6.7% to $5.5835/lb on a strong dollar and AI-spending doubts; wire costs remain elevated year over year, with ABC analysis of PPI data putting construction input prices up 11.5% year over year in October and copper wire and cable up 25.5%

Midterm results could accelerate state push for A3 refrigerants — ACHR News: ACCA, PHCC and HARDI warn differing state rules could push ultra-low-GWP A3 refrigerants such as R-290 (propane) before contractors have adjusted to the A2L transition, and urge contractors to monitor state legislation and comment early on proposed refrigerant and code changes

Markets in correction heading into Thanksgiving week — on Fri Nov 20 the S&P 500 fell 3.7% to 6,910.39, the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to 22,617.73 and the Dow fell 1.93% to 48,147.33; for the week the S&P 500 lost 8.6%, its worst week in more than 18 months, as the AI trade unwound; U.S. markets close Thu Nov 26 for Thanksgiving

Mortgage rates Sun Nov 22 — Bankrate's 30-year fixed national average is 7.41% today; Mortgage News Daily put the daily average at 7.33% on Fri Nov 20, down from 7.45% Thu as the stock selloff pushed bond yields down, Freddie Mac's weekly average was 7.28% on Nov 19, and CME FedWatch on Friday put a 91.4% chance on a 25-basis-point Fed hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting
news.source: Bankrate / Real Estate News / Freddie Mac

news.headline: NBA Sun Nov 22 — both Florida teams play tonight: Miami Heat (9-6) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (10-6) at 6 PM ET at Kaseya Center, and Orlando Magic (7-8) are at the Washington Wizards (6-11) at 7 PM ET at Capital One Arena; Magic are without Paolo Banchero (ankle) and Jonathan Isaac (knee)

NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22, early-game snapshot at 2:25 PM ET — Detroit Lions led the Tampa Bay Buccaneers (3-6) 10-7 at halftime and the Buffalo Bills led the Miami Dolphins (1-8) 20-6 in the second quarter; Jacksonville Jaguars (7-2) at New York Giants follows at 4:25 PM ET on CBS
